run_eval_mtp_model: run evaluation of an MTP model using lm_eval harness with a config file
run_launch_eval: run launch_eval to load a consolidated MTP model and evaluate it with lm_eval
run_eval_cli: run eval.py with a config file and dot-list CLI overrides for EvalArgs
review_launch_eval: review the launch_eval function that consolidates checkpoints, loads an LMTransformer, and runs lm_eval
review_main_config_merge: review the main function that merges default, file, and CLI OmegaConf configs for evaluation
